data.content: Plan correction: do not activate the legacy freeze in Wave 3. All current clients and the remaining e2e graph still write refs/heads/knots, so immediate enforcement would halt the graph. Wave 3 stages that exact ruleset while activating only v2 rules after signed-outbox support lands. knots-d6e4 owns the guarded legacy transition: install/enforce freeze, prove ordinary rejection, then capture the final legacy SHA and drain. GitHub inbox writes must be Actions-mediated and signed by a per-installation key whose fingerprint is the writer identity; direct wildcard inbox writes cannot provide credential scoping. The trusted workflow must construct canonical/archive/control objects from validated inputs rather than accepting caller-selected authority OIDs.
